main_measure.name: timing gain before costs on forecast>0 bars (position x (next-day return - coin mean)), summed per day across coins, mean over days

statistic.name: t of the mean over days

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 and top-minus-bottom < 0

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return, top third minus bottom third by forecast

reading: Days are UTC calendar dates of the bar's timestamp; the 300-day minimum counts distinct dates of forecast>0 bars with a valid next-day return inside their window; thirds are the n//3 highest and n//3 lowest forecast>0 bars pooled across coins after a stable sort by forecast; the excess return removes the coin's mean daily return over all its windows.
decided_by: Confirm rule: the daily timing gain has a mean above 0 with t >= 2 and the top third beats the bottom third.
